provenance.paper: Handling Concept Drift in Process Mining
provenance.citation: Bose, R.P.J.C., van der Aalst, W.M.P., Zliobaite, I., Pechenizkiy, M. (2011). Handling Concept Drift in Process Mining. CAiSE 2011.
provenance.locus: Section 3: windowed J-measure feature extraction over the directly-follows relation, compared across adjacent windows via a two-sample statistical test.

expected.description: Clean running-example log with uniform behavior yields no real, statistically-significant concept drift under the real J-measure + Kolmogorov-Smirnov two-sample test (Massey 1951 asymptotic critical value). Added 2026-08-12 as the real, separate companion to detect_drift.json's Jaccard/TV heuristic -- this fixture's algorithm genuinely implements the paper's own Section 3 pipeline (J-measure + KS-test), not merely inspired by it.
